description: Hand ownership of an agent in the Microsoft 365 agent catalogue to another user, by their Entra object id. Used when the owner leaves the organisation. The agent's owner inside a Power Platform environment is cs_reassign_agent_owner. Changes a live tenant: requires confirm: true. Needs CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All and runs against Graph beta (cs_login scope 'graph_write'). Needs a Microsoft Agent 365 licence and is global-cloud only. Unverified against a live tenant.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

id.description: Package id from cs_list_org_agents, e.g. P_19ae1zz1-56bc-505a-3d42-156df75a4xxy

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

userId.description: Entra object id of the new owner

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_reassign_org_agent
title: Reassign a catalogue agent's owner
